items.title: Treasurer signals tax and savings budget shake-up amid war uncertainty
items.description: The treasurer will outline how the May federal budget will respond to the crisis with a focus on "substantial" savings, productivity and tax changes to make the system fairer for younger Australians.

items.title: Australia can't predict how Trump ends this war, with or without allies
items.description: Even the best minds at Treasury can't know what will happen with global oil supplies, or how Donald Trump plans to end this war, with or without the help of allies.

items.title: Fuel price gouging may not be illegal, experts warn
items.description: Drivers fed up with massive price spikes at the bowser are being warned not to expect a wave of fuel company prosecutions over allegations of price gouging.

items.title: Iran confirms intelligence minister killed in Israeli strike, 12 dead in Beirut attack
items.description: Israel's defence minister, Israel Katz, says Iran's intelligence minister, Esmail Khatib, has been killed in air strikes overnight.

items.title: Iranian women's football team back in Iran, state media announces
items.description: The delegation of players and staff included five people who initially accepted Australia's offer of asylum but later changed their minds.

items.title: 'Cruise missile' drones and low-cost Shahed knockoffs listed on Alibaba
items.description: One-way attack drones described as "cruise missiles" were listed on the popular online retail platform Alibaba for less than $50,000, the ABC has found.

items.title: Australia Zoo was Old Faithful's supposed 'forever home'. The totemic croc remains unsighted
items.description: Missing: One 80-year-old, 4.5 metre totemic crocodile. Last known whereabouts: Australia Zoo. Welcome to the fight for Old Faithful.

items.title: Why don't Australian banks offer 30-year fixed-rate home loans?
items.description: A new report says Australian borrowers would benefit from 30-year fixed-rate home loans, and they should be made available.

items.title: Urgent call to ensure all babies are born a healthy weight
items.description: The Productivity Commission’s latest Closing the Gap data shows just four out of 19 targets are on track. Advocates call for urgent funding to address low birth weights.

items.title: Property sellers turning profits at highest rate in the past 15 years
items.description: Australian home owners now have the protection of a "financial shield" in uncertain times, a report by property portal Domain has found, but record profits from property resales are widening the gap between established owners and aspiring first home buyers.

items.title: 'Very rare': Some South Australians will vote twice this weekend
items.description: Thousands of First Nations South Australians will be eligible to vote in two elections on Saturday, in a potential historic first for the state.

items.title: Severe Cyclone Narelle upgraded to category three system
items.description: Tropical Cyclone Narelle could threaten Queensland coast as a severe category five system this week.

items.title: Australia to toughen tobacco crime laws as illegal vape market surges
items.description: Criminal gangs cashing in on Australia's illicit tobacco boom will face tougher penalties and expanded police surveillance powers in a fresh crackdown on the black market.

items.title: Daily heart surgeries cut back to twice a week due to strikes
items.description: Daily heart surgeries have been cut to two a week in Tasmania while a small group of crucial specialists strikes for better pay and conditions. But negotiations with the government have halted, and locums are being sought to plug resulting healthcare gaps.

items.title: No evidence for psychedelics and depression despite 'hype'
items.description: Despite growing interest in psychedelics and cannabis for treating depression, evidence the treatments work is limited.

items.title: Ryan Gosling is humanity's last hope in this new space epic
items.description: Project Hail Mary hits Australian cinemas this week, joining Oscar-nominated animation Arco, off-the-wall slasher Dolly and BAFTA-winning biopic I Swear.

items.title: Put your 2026 Oscars knowledge to the test with our Academy Awards quiz
items.description: Awards season might be over for another year but the memories will live on in our minds … and in the questions of this Academy Awards quiz.

items.title: Quick hits: Matildas put on notice as Japan soar into Asian Cup final
items.description: Ultimate control, goals from everywhere and an eccentric coach from Greenland. This is what we learned from Japan's supremely impressive semifinal victory over South Korea.

items.title: Military officers arrested over acid attack on Indonesian activist
items.description: Four Indonesian officers have been arrested and detained over an acid attack on human rights campaigner Andrie Yunus in Jakarta.

items.title: 'Absolute disaster': Media analysts weigh in on Sandilands sacking
items.description: Shock jock Kyle Sandilands was likely sacked because of pressure from the media regulator and his huge $100 million contract, former ABC Media Watch host Paul Barry says.

items.title: Chronic conditions dismissed as anxiety, low iron
items.description: Young women have detailed their experiences being dismissed and misdiagnosed as chronic pain sufferers. Now, they're teaching others how to advocate for their health.

items.title: Japan storm into Asian Cup final against Matildas with ominous dismantling of South Korea
items.description: Japan has produced a frighteningly good display to overpower South Korea 4-1, and book a spot in the Women's Asian Cup final against the Matildas.

items.title: Man faces court charged with rape and murder of 62yo woman in brothel
items.description: A forensic pathologist has told a committal hearing for Michael James Chalmers she believed the 62-year-old woman died from neck compression, smothering or gagging.

items.title: 'Moment of pride': Venezuela edges US to win first World Baseball Classic
items.description: Venezuela claims its first World Baseball Classic championship with a 3-2 win over the United States in Miami.

items.title: Transparency motions pass parliament without government support
items.description: Tasmania's minority parliament has delivered the Liberal government a stinging verdict on integrity and transparency, with two motions passed without the government's support.
